evidence_rule.unit: venue x surface (芝/ダ); no cross-venue carry-over
evidence_rule.venue_rule: promote needs >= 2 decisive venue x surface cells in the same direction and none opposite (runtime/analysis/jra_oos_strata.py venue_rule)

arms.keep_if: at 100R the 95% CI upper bound <= +0.10 and venue_rule != CONSISTENT_DEGRADATION
arms.revert_review_if: at 100R CI lower bound > 0 (v1.1 worse) or venue_rule == CONSISTENT_DEGRADATION -> Owner review

arms.metric: winner rank and top-3 capture with vs without Keibabook features
arms.keep_if: at 100R mean winner rank not worse by > 0.10 and venue_rule != CONSISTENT_DEGRADATION
arms.revert_review_if: at 100R mean winner rank worse by > 0.25 or CONSISTENT_DEGRADATION -> Owner review

arms.metric: net profit change vs frozen Production tickets
arms.promote_if: at 300R net profit change > 0, PFS excl. max payout not lower, venue_rule == CONSISTENT_IMPROVEMENT
arms.reject_if: at 100R net profit change < 0 and PFS excl. max payout lower

arms.metric: net profit change; must beat P2_STATIC_NEXT_CONTROL to credit KRS
arms.promote_if: at 300R beats both baseline and P2_STATIC_NEXT_CONTROL on net profit and PFS excl. max payout, venue_rule == CONSISTENT_IMPROVEMENT
control arm; promotion only by a separate Owner decision

note: Owner decision files override reporting for an arm (e.g. hold to 300R); trackers must read them before re-reporting.
